suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(ggplot2)
})
# Read data
df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
# Build list of sets, removing NA values from each column
sets <- lapply(df, function(col) na.omit(unique(col)))
cat("Group sizes:\n")
print(sapply(sets, length))
# Build a proportional Venn diagram (Euler approximation)
p <- ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0, edge_lwd = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4FAFE", high = "#4981BF") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black","black","black","black","black")) +
  labs(title = "5 -set synthetic Venn diagram",
       subtitle = paste("A =", length(sets$A),
                        "; B =", length(sets$B),
                        "; C =", length(sets$C),
                        "; D =", length(sets$D),
                        "; E =", length(sets$E))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right")
ggsave("venn_proportional_5sets.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
ggsave("venn_proportional_5sets.pdf", p, width = 9, height = 7)
cat("\nSaved: venn_proportional_5sets.png / .pdf\n")
print(p)

# Produce also a numeric table of region counts and an UpSet-like alternative view
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(VennDiagram)
})
df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
sets <- lapply(df, function(col) na.omit(unique(col)))
# Region counts via VennDiagram::get.venn.partitions
res <- VennDiagram::get.venn.partitions(sets)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
cat("Region counts (intersection table):\n")
print(res_df)
# Save region table
write.csv(res_df, "venn_region_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved: venn_region_counts.csv\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(VennDiagram)
})
df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
sets <- lapply(df, function(col) na.omit(unique(col)))
res <- VennDiagram::get.venn.partitions(sets)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
# Drop list-column (elements) so write.csv is happy
if ("..values.." %in% names(res_df)) res_df[["..values.."]] <- NULL
res_df$count <- lengths(res[["..values.."]])  # intersection size
res_df <- res_df[, c("A","B","C","D","E","count","..set..")]
names(res_df)[names(res_df) == "..set.."] <- "region"
write.csv(res_df, "venn_region_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Wrote region counts. Rows:", nrow(res_df), "\n")
print(head(res_df, 31))

# Re-render with a slightly nicer style and label inside regions
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(ggplot2)
})
df <- read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
sets <- lapply(df, function(col) na.omit(unique(col)))
p <- ggVennDiagram(
  sets,
  label_alpha = 0,
  edge_lwd = 0.6,
  set_size = 5
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#1F4E79", name = "Element count") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "5 -set synthetic Venn diagram",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "A = %d | B = %d | C = %d | D = %d | E = %d",
      length(sets$A), length(sets$B), length(sets$C),
      length(sets$D), length(sets$E)
    )
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
ggsave("venn_proportional_5sets.png", p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
ggsave("venn_proportional_5sets.pdf", p, width = 9, height = 7, bg = "white")
cat("Saved PNG and PDF.\n")
print(p)
